traits.trait_name: Possessed by the Wrath of Rudra (Shiva)
Born of Fire for Drona's Destruction

astras.name: Brahmastra
astras.restrictions: Cannot be used against non-Maharathis without extreme Dharma penalty. Can be recalled.

astras.name: Brahmashira Astra
astras.restrictions: More powerful than Brahmastra. Two Brahmashiras colliding could destroy the world. Must be recalled if opponent withdraws theirs.

astras.name: Pashupatastra
astras.restrictions: Given by Shiva to Arjuna. Can destroy creation. Usable only in specific canonical nodes. Cannot be used against lesser warriors.

astras.name: Narayanastra
astras.restrictions: Can only be used once. Grows stronger against resistance. Countered only by complete submission. Wielded by Ashwatthama.

astras.name: Agneyastra
astras.restrictions: Fire-based. Countered by Varunastra. Widespread area damage.

astras.name: Varunastra
astras.restrictions: Water-based. Counters Agneyastra. Floods terrain tiles.

astras.name: Shakti Astra (Indra's Dart)
astras.restrictions: Single-use weapon given by Indra to Karna in exchange for his Kavacha-Kundala. Infallible kill on one target. Karna saves it for Arjuna but is forced to use it on Ghatotkacha.

astras.name: Bhargavastra
astras.restrictions: Taught by Parashurama to Karna. Multi-target devastation.

astras.name: Sudarshana Chakra
astras.restrictions: Krishna's personal weapon. Vowed not to use it in the war. If used, triggers massive Dharma Imbalance.

astras.name: Vaishnavastra
astras.restrictions: Infallible weapon of Vishnu. Countered only by devotion.

astras.name: Sammohana Astra
astras.restrictions: Causes unconsciousness. Non-lethal. Arjuna uses it against the Kaurava army at Virata.

vows_boons.name: Bhishma's Terrible Vow (Pratigya)
vows_boons.description: Devavrata swore lifelong celibacy and renounced the throne so his father Shantanu could marry Satyavati. For this sacrifice he was named Bhishma.
vows_boons.fulfillment_condition: Maintained until death on the bed of arrows.

vows_boons.name: Protector of the Kuru Throne
vows_boons.description: Bhishma vowed to protect whoever sits on the Kuru throne, binding him to fight for Duryodhana despite knowing his cause is unjust.
vows_boons.fulfillment_condition: Active until Bhishma falls.

vows_boons.name: Amba's Vengeance
vows_boons.description: Princess Amba, humiliated by Bhishma's refusal to marry her, immolated herself and was reborn as Shikhandi to cause his death.
vows_boons.fulfillment_condition: Shikhandi stands before Bhishma in battle. Bhishma lowers his arms.

vows_boons.name: A Kshatriya Cannot Refuse a Challenge
vows_boons.description: Yudhishthira, bound by Kshatriya dharma, cannot refuse a direct challenge to a game of dice.
vows_boons.fulfillment_condition: Triggered whenever Sabha is replayed.

vows_boons.name: Yudhishthira's Commitment to Truth
vows_boons.description: Yudhishthira has never spoken a lie. Breaking this (even once) has world-altering consequences — his chariot, which hovers above the ground, will touch the earth.
vows_boons.fulfillment_condition: Broken during Drona Parva when he says 'Ashwatthama is dead — the elephant.'

vows_boons.name: Bhima's Oath Against Duhshasana
vows_boons.description: After Duhshasana dragged Draupadi by her hair and attempted to disrobe her, Bhima swore to tear open his chest and drink his blood.
vows_boons.fulfillment_condition: Bhima slays Duhshasana in Shalya Parva.

vows_boons.name: Bhima's Oath Against Duryodhana
vows_boons.description: When Duryodhana bared his thigh to Draupadi, Bhima swore to break it with his mace.
vows_boons.fulfillment_condition: Fulfilled in the mace duel during Shalya Parva.

vows_boons.name: Draupadi's Untied Hair
vows_boons.description: Draupadi swore never to tie her hair until it was washed with Duhshasana's blood.
vows_boons.fulfillment_condition: Fulfilled when Bhima brings her his blood in Shalya Parva.

vows_boons.name: Arjuna's Vow to Slay Jayadratha
vows_boons.description: After Abhimanyu's death, Arjuna swore to kill Jayadratha before sunset the next day, or immolate himself.
vows_boons.fulfillment_condition: Arjuna slays Jayadratha before sunset on Day 14. Krishna creates an artificial eclipse to lure Jayadratha out.

vows_boons.name: Karna's Perpetual Generosity
vows_boons.description: Karna vowed never to refuse anyone who asks during his morning prayers. Indra exploits this to take his Kavacha-Kundala.
vows_boons.fulfillment_condition: Exploited pre-war. Indra takes the armor; gives Shakti Astra in return.

vows_boons.name: Karna's Lifelong Rivalry
vows_boons.description: Karna swore to prove himself the greatest archer, surpassing Arjuna.
vows_boons.fulfillment_condition: Resolved in their final duel during Karna Parva.

vows_boons.name: Krishna's Vow of Non-Combat
vows_boons.description: Krishna promised not to wield weapons during the war. He serves only as Arjuna's charioteer. Nearly breaks this vow on Day 9.
vows_boons.fulfillment_condition: Maintained throughout the war (with one near-breach).

vows_boons.name: Duty of the Teacher
vows_boons.description: Drona and Kripa are bound by guru-dharma to fight for the side that feeds them, even against their own students.
vows_boons.fulfillment_condition: Active until their respective deaths.

vows_boons.name: Shakuni's Secret Oath
vows_boons.description: Shakuni swore to destroy the Kuru dynasty from within to avenge his family's humiliation by Dhritarashtra.
vows_boons.fulfillment_condition: Fulfilled by the annihilation of both sides at Kurukshetra.

vows_boons.name: Kunti's Hidden Truth
vows_boons.description: Kunti kept secret that Karna is her firstborn son, abandoned at birth. She reveals this to Karna before the war.
vows_boons.fulfillment_condition: Revealed in Udyoga Parva. Karna refuses to switch sides but promises to spare all Pandavas except Arjuna.

vows_boons.name: Gandhari's Self-Imposed Blindfold
vows_boons.description: When Gandhari learned her husband was blind, she blindfolded herself permanently out of devotion. This accumulated immense pativrata shakti.
vows_boons.fulfillment_condition: Culminates in her curse upon Krishna after the war.

vows_boons.name: Sanjaya's Duty to Report
vows_boons.description: Sanjaya is tasked with reporting the war truthfully to the blind Dhritarashtra, using divya-drishti granted by Vyasa.
vows_boons.fulfillment_condition: Active for the duration of the 18-day war.

vows_boons.name: Dhrishtadyumna's Destiny
vows_boons.description: Dhrishtadyumna was born from the sacrificial fire specifically to kill Drona.
vows_boons.fulfillment_condition: Fulfilled when he beheads Drona in Drona Parva.

vows_boons.name: Karna's Natural Armor
vows_boons.description: Karna was born with divine golden armor (Kavacha) and earrings (Kundala) that made him virtually invincible. Indra tricked him into donating them.
vows_boons.fulfillment_condition: Removed before the war. Without them, Karna is mortal.

vows_boons.name: Parashurama's Curse on Karna
vows_boons.description: Parashurama cursed Karna: he would forget how to invoke the Brahmastra at the moment he needs it most.
vows_boons.fulfillment_condition: Activated during Karna's final duel with Arjuna.

vows_boons.name: Brahmin's Curse on Karna
vows_boons.description: A brahmin cursed Karna that the earth would swallow his chariot wheel at his moment of greatest need.
vows_boons.fulfillment_condition: Activated during the final duel — his chariot wheel sinks into the ground.
